incidents.TITLE: Aiven transfer/storage quota exhaustion
incidents.ORIGINAL_FAILURE: Optional bulk archive writes kept retrying after the Aiven transfer/storage quota (SQLSTATE 53000) was exhausted, starving required evidence writes.
incidents.ROOT_CAUSE: Quota exhaustion was not classified distinctly from transient failures, so it was retried instead of cooled down.
incidents.FIX: src/storage/local-research-archive-health.ts persists a quota cooldown and src/theta/runtime-postgres-client.ts refuses to loop on transfer-quota failures.

REGRESSION_TEST.titleFragment: quota exhaustion persists a cooldown
transfer quota and read-only failures do not loop

incidents.TITLE: DNS failure to database host
incidents.ORIGINAL_FAILURE: A transient DNS failure to the database host was treated as strategy evidence or an unclassified error.
incidents.ROOT_CAUSE: DNS/connection phases were not kept distinct and infrastructure failure leaked into strategy results.
incidents.FIX: tools/theta-database-recovery-gate.mjs and src/theta/postgres-connection-characterization.ts classify DNS failure as infrastructure only.

REGRESSION_TEST.titleFragment: rejects transient DNS failure
unavailable DNS and TLS boundaries remain null

incidents.TITLE: Database connection acquisition timeout / pool exhaustion
incidents.ORIGINAL_FAILURE: Soak and runtime work queued behind a saturated pool and failed with connection-acquisition timeouts that looked like strategy failures.
incidents.ROOT_CAUSE: Concurrency exceeded pool capacity (six-on-two pattern) and pool-wait versus physical-connect timeouts were not distinguished.
incidents.FIX: src/theta/runtime-postgres-client.ts, src/theta/runtime-postgres-pool.ts and src/theta/bounded-concurrency.ts bound concurrency to pool capacity and type acquisition failures.

REGRESSION_TEST.titleFragment: old six-on-two soak pattern deterministically creates its own queue timeout
pool queue timeout and new-connection timeout have distinct acquisition paths

incidents.TITLE: Schema/runtime build mismatch (RUNTIME_SCHEMA_INCOMPATIBLE)
incidents.ORIGINAL_FAILURE: A schema-064 worker reached migration-067 persistence SQL and failed with 42703 undefined column.
incidents.ROOT_CAUSE: The runtime did not verify schema/source/worker identity compatibility before registering, leasing or starting a cycle.
incidents.FIX: src/theta/runtime-schema-compatibility.ts gates registration, lease and cycle start with a typed fail-closed RUNTIME_SCHEMA_INCOMPATIBLE state.

REGRESSION_TEST.titleFragment: schema 064 is a typed fail-closed state before lease or cycle work
locked worker survives a real schema-064 IV persistence failure

incidents.TITLE: Duplicate worker / lease overlap
incidents.ORIGINAL_FAILURE: Two workers or overlapping invocations could run primary work concurrently.
incidents.ROOT_CAUSE: Worker lease ownership and request windows were not enforced at startup and at the point of mutation.
incidents.FIX: src/worker/resident-worker.ts, src/theta/runtime-request-lease.ts and src/execution/mutation-fence.ts enforce a single primary lease and fence stale invocations.

REGRESSION_TEST.titleFragment: worker refuses startup when another primary master Paper lease is active
OVERLAP: 400 seeded interleavings never create a duplicate economic order

incidents.TITLE: Worker heartbeat failure
incidents.ORIGINAL_FAILURE: A worker that lost its lease kept running as if it still held it.
incidents.ROOT_CAUSE: Lease renewal did not report loss to the holder.
incidents.FIX: src/worker/postgres-worker-runtime-store.ts reports false on renewal when the lease is not held and refuses takeover of an unexpired foreign lease.

REGRESSION_TEST.titleFragment: HEARTBEAT: a worker that no longer holds an unexpired lease is told so
HEARTBEAT: acquiring a lease held by another unexpired owner is HELD_BY_OTHER

incidents.TITLE: Environment mismatch (environment variables)
incidents.ORIGINAL_FAILURE: The worker could silently inherit legacy or generic database authority or accept malformed environment values.
incidents.ROOT_CAUSE: Database/provider authority was not derived from explicit named environment configuration.
incidents.FIX: src/config/environment.ts selects the Aiven runtime authority explicitly and fails closed with typed configuration errors.

REGRESSION_TEST.titleFragment: Production worker cannot silently inherit legacy or generic database authority
FUZZ environment

incidents.TITLE: HTTP 503 from the evidence server
incidents.ORIGINAL_FAILURE: Evidence cycles returned HTTP 503 and the Windows worker mishandled non-HTTP failures.
incidents.ROOT_CAUSE: Server errors and non-HTTP errors were dereferenced as if every failure carried an HTTP response.
incidents.FIX: tools/windows/theta-local-worker.ps1 and src/worker/resident-worker.ts retain only safe HTTP metadata and classify non-HTTP errors.

REGRESSION_TEST.titleFragment: worker error handling never dereferences an assumed HTTP response
the Postgres frontier projection stays bounded

incidents.CURRENT_STATUS: PARTIAL (the 503 mechanism (payload bound) and safe HTTP-error handling are each tested; no end-to-end test drives a real 503 through the Windows worker)

incidents.TITLE: PowerShell quoting and path defects
incidents.ORIGINAL_FAILURE: Arguments containing spaces, quotes, dollar signs, backticks and paths with spaces were mangled when a command line was built as one string.
incidents.ROOT_CAUSE: Child processes were launched with a composed command string rather than discrete arguments.
incidents.FIX: tools/windows/ThetaProcess.Common.ps1 (Invoke-ThetaBoundedProcess) passes each argument as a discrete value.

REGRESSION_TEST.titleFragment: THETA_PROCESS_QUOTING_TEST=PASS

incidents.TITLE: Pagination defects
incidents.ORIGINAL_FAILURE: Option contract, snapshot and order enumeration returned incomplete or duplicated sets when results spanned multiple pages.
incidents.ROOT_CAUSE: Single-page assumptions, repeated tokens and missing page caps made incomplete sets look complete.
incidents.FIX: src/theta/alpaca-provider.ts follows page tokens to completion, deduplicates, marks incompleteness and fails closed on repeated tokens.

REGRESSION_TEST.titleFragment: fetchOptionContracts follows next_page_token to completion
repeated or empty page tokens fail closed

incidents.TITLE: False contract UNKNOWN
incidents.ORIGINAL_FAILURE: Complete contract snapshots were labelled UNKNOWN and non-executable.
incidents.ROOT_CAUSE: Merge logic lost snapshot data for contracts that did in fact have complete quotes.
incidents.FIX: src/theta/option-chain-ingestion.ts and src/theta/canonical-strategy-frontier.ts merge snapshots so complete contracts are known and a missing snapshot alone is UNKNOWN.

REGRESSION_TEST.titleFragment: FALSE UNKNOWN: 200 contracts with complete snapshots

incidents.TITLE: Strategy version hash mismatch
incidents.ORIGINAL_FAILURE: A strategy version row whose persisted config hash differed from the source payload could be used silently.
incidents.ROOT_CAUSE: Version upsert did not verify the persisted hash against the source payload.
incidents.FIX: src/research/master-shadow-context.ts throws SHADOW_CONTEXT_VERSION_HASH_MISMATCH or UNRESOLVED instead of returning a mismatching id.

REGRESSION_TEST.titleFragment: STRATEGY VERSION: a persisted config hash

incidents.TITLE: Archive overflow
incidents.ORIGINAL_FAILURE: Complete cycle archives larger than the optional spool cap were lost or silently truncated.
incidents.ROOT_CAUSE: The 4 MiB optional local spool cap was applied to evidence that must remain complete.
incidents.FIX: src/theta/cycle-archive-replay.ts and src/storage/local-research-history-spool.ts keep compressed complete archives replayable and reject silent truncation.

REGRESSION_TEST.titleFragment: a compressed cycle archive replays a T0 larger than the optional 4 MiB spool cap
cycle reads scope subjects before the bound and reject silent truncation

incidents.TITLE: Frontier memory blowup
incidents.ORIGINAL_FAILURE: Large option chains made frontier construction and retained payloads grow without bound in memory.
incidents.ROOT_CAUSE: Per-candidate detail was retained and dominance computation was not bounded for large chains.
incidents.FIX: src/theta/canonical-strategy-frontier.ts bounds candidates, dominance witnesses and the queryable projection independent of chain size.

REGRESSION_TEST.titleFragment: memory: serialized sizes are linear
frontier is correct and bounded at 500 / 2000 / 5000 contracts

incidents.TITLE: Optionomics duplication
incidents.ORIGINAL_FAILURE: Derived Optionomics context was duplicated per candidate and duplicate contracts amplified context.
incidents.ROOT_CAUSE: Shared context was embedded in every candidate and duplicate provider rows were not collapsed.
incidents.FIX: src/theta/canonical-strategy-frontier.ts carries shared context once per frontier and src/theta/optionomics-provider.ts deduplicates contracts without choosing conflicting revisions.

REGRESSION_TEST.titleFragment: the shared optionomics context and routing payload are carried once per frontier
duplicate Optionomics contracts cannot amplify context

incidents.TITLE: False runtime-observed labels
incidents.ORIGINAL_FAILURE: Shadow or never-selected evidence could be labelled as observed/runtime-observed.
incidents.ROOT_CAUSE: Observation-kind labels were not validated against the evidence actually available.
incidents.FIX: src/research/empirical-identifiability-taxonomy.ts and src/research/universe-opportunity-regret.ts reject observed labels without real observation.

REGRESSION_TEST.titleFragment: a shadow-only prediction can never be labeled OBSERVED_PARALLEL
a never-traded candidate is REJECTED if labeled OBSERVED_REAL_CHAIN

incidents.CURRENT_STATUS: PARTIAL (taxonomy and regret labels are validated; a whole-board label audit is covered by the board test only)

incidents.TITLE: A/C false credit
incidents.ORIGINAL_FAILURE: Held-stock covered-call/sell-stock candidates (A/C) could be credited as new-risk winners or with fabricated credit.
incidents.ROOT_CAUSE: A/C candidates were not routed to management authority and unknown credit was coerced to zero.
incidents.FIX: src/theta/canonical-strategy-frontier.ts routes A/C to management authority and src/theta/assignment-utility.ts keeps unknown opening credit UNKNOWN.

REGRESSION_TEST.titleFragment: A/C applicable stock routes new-risk selection to management authority
AUTHORITY: A and C candidates

incidents.TITLE: Q misattribution
incidents.ORIGINAL_FAILURE: Q candidate economics could be attributed to the wrong contract or quote.
incidents.ROOT_CAUSE: Economics did not carry the exact contract, bid, ask and quote timestamp.
incidents.FIX: src/theta/canonical-strategy-frontier.ts records exact contract, bid, ask, spread and quote timestamp on every Q candidate.

REGRESSION_TEST.titleFragment: every Q candidate economics record carries the exact contract

incidents.CURRENT_STATUS: PARTIAL (exact-contract carriage is pinned; no randomized cross-candidate attribution sweep exists)

incidents.TITLE: AEGIS cross-candidate contamination
incidents.ORIGINAL_FAILURE: A hard veto on one candidate altered state or quantity of other candidates.
incidents.ROOT_CAUSE: Risk state was shared across candidates and order-dependent.
incidents.FIX: src/theta/canonical-strategy-frontier.ts evaluates AEGIS per candidate in isolation.

REGRESSION_TEST.titleFragment: AEGIS ISOLATION: a HARD_VETO on one candidate

incidents.TITLE: Command-5A lineage loss
incidents.ORIGINAL_FAILURE: Command-5A jobs lost the first-episode source and worker identity across release cutovers.
incidents.ROOT_CAUSE: Later decisions overwrote the first episode lineage on scheduled jobs.
incidents.FIX: src/research/command5a-local-scheduling.ts preserves first-episode sourceSha and workerSha on every job.

REGRESSION_TEST.titleFragment: repeated decisions in one governed bucket retain the first immutable T0 subject

incidents.TITLE: V8 heap limit exceeded
incidents.ORIGINAL_FAILURE: The worker approached the V8 heap limit during large-chain or long-running work.
incidents.ROOT_CAUSE: Unbounded retained evidence and per-cycle accumulation.
incidents.FIX: src/theta/canonical-strategy-frontier.ts bounded projections reduce retained size; no explicit heap-limit configuration exists in the repository.

REGRESSION_TEST.titleFragment: no heap trend
peak RSS stays inside budget

incidents.CURRENT_STATUS: PARTIAL (bounded memory is proven by soak and stress budgets; the V8 heap flag itself is not configured or tested)

incidents.TITLE: Parquet verification cache
incidents.ORIGINAL_FAILURE: Parquet archive verification trusted a cache or manifest shortcut and could miss tampering.
incidents.ROOT_CAUSE: The cache short-circuited content verification of legacy archives.
incidents.FIX: tools/verify-local-research-parquet.py always re-verifies legacy archive content despite a cache file.

REGRESSION_TEST.titleFragment: test_verifies_legacy_archive_without_a_manifest_only_cache_shortcut

incidents.TITLE: Generic WAIT without a specific reason
incidents.ORIGINAL_FAILURE: WAIT decisions were recorded without a specific reason, hiding why no trade was taken.
incidents.ROOT_CAUSE: WAIT reasons were optional free text.
incidents.FIX: src/theta/opportunity-frontier-contract.ts and src/theta/shadow-opportunity-book.ts require a specific waitReason.

REGRESSION_TEST.titleFragment: WAIT must carry a specific waitReason
a WAIT outcome must carry a specific waitReason, never a generic WAIT

incidents.TITLE: Duplicate candidate inflation
incidents.ORIGINAL_FAILURE: Duplicate copies of one contract or candidate id manufactured extra alternatives or double counts.
incidents.ROOT_CAUSE: Candidates were not deduplicated by exact contract identity.
incidents.FIX: src/theta/canonical-strategy-frontier.ts deduplicates exact broker contracts before enumeration.

REGRESSION_TEST.titleFragment: duplicate copies of one exact broker contract cannot manufacture a second Q alternative
duplicate D contracts cannot inflate bounded spread pair enumeration

incidents.TITLE: Raw replay loss
incidents.ORIGINAL_FAILURE: Persisted cycle evidence could not be replayed faithfully from raw inputs.
incidents.ROOT_CAUSE: Replay bundles lacked a whole-bundle integrity hash and complete archives.
incidents.FIX: src/theta/cycle-archive-replay.ts verifies archive hashes and the T0 bundle carries a whole-bundle integrity hash.

REGRESSION_TEST.titleFragment: persisted complete cycle archive replays through canonical frontier without a provider call
TAMPER: every single persisted leaf

incidents.TITLE: Universe/management UNKNOWN coerced to zero
incidents.ORIGINAL_FAILURE: Missing account, exposure or EV evidence was coerced to numeric zero.
incidents.ROOT_CAUSE: Absent values were defaulted instead of kept UNKNOWN.
incidents.FIX: src/theta/account-exposure.ts and src/theta/canonical-strategy-frontier.ts keep unknown values as null.

REGRESSION_TEST.titleFragment: null equity makes every derived ratio UNKNOWN
JSON round-trip preserves null EV exactly

incidents.TITLE: Pareto memory growth
incidents.ORIGINAL_FAILURE: Exact Pareto dominance over large frontiers grew memory and time quadratically.
incidents.ROOT_CAUSE: Full pairwise dominance sets were retained.
incidents.FIX: src/theta/canonical-strategy-frontier.ts keeps exact rank with bounded deterministic dominance witnesses.

REGRESSION_TEST.titleFragment: large frontiers retain exact Pareto rank with bounded, deterministic dominance witnesses

incidents.TITLE: Python omission
incidents.ORIGINAL_FAILURE: Python authority or research layers could be silently omitted or unavailable without a typed failure.
incidents.ROOT_CAUSE: Bridge and research boundaries did not always fail closed or run.
incidents.FIX: src/theta/python-bridge.ts fails closed with typed errors; phase 5 and 6 tests execute the Python authority boundaries.

REGRESSION_TEST.titleFragment: Phase-5 executed Python authority rejects malformed inputs
process unavailable (bad executable path) fails closed as PROCESS_ERROR

incidents.CURRENT_STATUS: PARTIAL (Python boundaries fail closed and execute in phase 5/6 tests; no test deletes the interpreter inside the full cycle)

incidents.TITLE: Fake idle/NORMAL status
incidents.ORIGINAL_FAILURE: Unknown or invalid state was reported as idle, NORMAL or a single combined inactivity number.
incidents.ROOT_CAUSE: Defaults to NORMAL hid unknown drawdown and conflated inactivity classes.
incidents.FIX: src/research/account-drawdown-regime-research.ts never defaults unknown to NORMAL.

REGRESSION_TEST.titleFragment: CORE CLAIM: unknown drawdown is never defaulted to NORMAL
CORE CLAIM: rates are reported separately, never combined into one inactivity number

incidents.CURRENT_STATUS: PARTIAL (unknown-never-NORMAL and separate inactivity classes are tested; the status endpoint idle label has no dedicated test)

incidents.TITLE: Subject limit
incidents.ORIGINAL_FAILURE: Long-lived research subjects grew without a bound or collided across underlyings.
incidents.ROOT_CAUSE: Subject identity was not bounded by decision cadence or namespaced by underlying.
incidents.FIX: src/research/serious-subject-policy.ts bounds subjects by cadence and namespaces them by underlying.

REGRESSION_TEST.titleFragment: long-lived identities are cadence-bounded
subject identities are isolated by underlying namespace

incidents.TITLE: Provenance and timestamp defects
incidents.ORIGINAL_FAILURE: Raw evidence timestamps were backdated or rewritten to decision time.
incidents.ROOT_CAUSE: As-of time was taken from request start or decision time rather than actual retrieval time.
incidents.FIX: src/theta/alpaca-corporate-action-evidence.ts and src/theta/optionomics-provider.ts record true retrieval time and quarantine future or malformed times.

REGRESSION_TEST.titleFragment: event receipt time is after response acquisition
raw Optionomics as-of is retrieval time

incidents.TITLE: Fresh-checkpoint starvation
incidents.ORIGINAL_FAILURE: Fresh exact checkpoints were starved behind an irrecoverable historical backlog.
incidents.ROOT_CAUSE: The scheduler drained oldest work first without priority for fresh checkpoints.
incidents.FIX: src/storage/local-observation-job-scheduler.ts prioritises fresh exact checkpoints over an irrecoverable backlog.

REGRESSION_TEST.titleFragment: fresh exact checkpoints are not starved
an exhausted read-only checkpoint cannot permanently suppress fresh evidence

incidents.TITLE: First-order canary lock
incidents.ORIGINAL_FAILURE: A prior broker order did not keep the single-canary lane locked until acceptance, or never released it afterwards.
incidents.ROOT_CAUSE: The lane lock was not derived from durable order and acceptance evidence.
incidents.FIX: src/theta/autonomous-runtime.ts and src/execution/postgres-first-canary-acceptance.ts derive the lane lock from the audit record.

REGRESSION_TEST.titleFragment: a prior broker order keeps the single-canary lane locked until acceptance

incidents.TITLE: Post-canary relock
incidents.ORIGINAL_FAILURE: The first-canary relock could re-pause new risk after autonomy had been accepted.
incidents.ROOT_CAUSE: The relock call site did not distinguish an already-accepted canary.
incidents.FIX: src/theta/autonomous-runtime.ts skips relock for a completed canary; src/execution/postgres-first-canary-acceptance.ts records acceptance.

REGRESSION_TEST.titleFragment: the first-canary relock can never re-pause new risk after autonomy was accepted
real disposable PostgreSQL: accepted first canary promotes to autonomous Master Paper

incidents.TITLE: Mutable changed_by audit marker
incidents.ORIGINAL_FAILURE: The accepted-canary marker was read from a mutable changed_by column that could be rewritten.
incidents.ROOT_CAUSE: Acceptance state was derived from a mutable control row instead of the immutable audit record.
incidents.FIX: src/theta/autonomous-runtime.ts reads the accepted-canary marker from the immutable audit record only.

REGRESSION_TEST.titleFragment: the durable accepted-canary marker is read from the immutable audit record only

incidents.TITLE: Multi-order deadlock / chain starvation
incidents.ORIGINAL_FAILURE: Fill-lifecycle application for several chains could stall on one failing chain.
incidents.ROOT_CAUSE: Chains were applied serially and a coded rejection on one aborted the rest.
incidents.FIX: src/execution/postgres-broker-fill-lifecycle-orchestrator.ts reports a coded rejection as unresolved and continues with other chains.

REGRESSION_TEST.titleFragment: a coded domain rejection for one chain is reported as unresolved and does not stop the other chains

incidents.CURRENT_STATUS: PARTIAL (a coded rejection no longer stops other chains; a many-chain concurrent lifecycle stress is not built)

incidents.TITLE: Frontier payload HTTP 503
incidents.ORIGINAL_FAILURE: The queryable frontier projection exceeded the 768 KiB inline policy on full SPY chains, returning HTTP 503 and dropping evidence cycles.
incidents.ROOT_CAUSE: Per-candidate exclusion and eligibility lists were embedded in the projection (about 300 bytes per contract).
incidents.FIX: src/theta/canonical-strategy-frontier.ts and src/theta/postgres-cycle-evidence-storage.ts bound the projection to a constant size with full detail in the compressed cycle archive.

REGRESSION_TEST.titleFragment: the Postgres frontier projection stays bounded at 300 / 2619 / 5000 contracts

incidents.TITLE: Snapshot keeper loss during DR dump
incidents.ORIGINAL_FAILURE: The exported-snapshot keeper session disappeared during a multi-hour dump and the backup failed with snapshot does not exist.
incidents.ROOT_CAUSE: The idle keeper connection was reaped or lost and its death was not detected.
incidents.FIX: tools/windows/dr/ThetaBackup.Common.ps1 keeps the keeper active with a heartbeat, records its death and asserts it alive after the dump.

REGRESSION_TEST.titleFragment: THETA_SNAPSHOT_HEARTBEAT_TEST=PASS
THETA_SNAPSHOT_KEEPER_ASSERT_TEST=PASS

incidents.TITLE: Backup sequence parity
incidents.ORIGINAL_FAILURE: Restore verification failed on exact sequence equality after a live dump advanced sequences.
incidents.ROOT_CAUSE: Sequences are non-transactional and advance while the dump runs.
incidents.FIX: tools/windows/dr/Restore-Theta.ps1 and tools/windows/dr/ThetaBackup.Common.ps1 accept restored sequences that lag but never lead the source.

REGRESSION_TEST.titleFragment: restored AHEAD of source

incidents.TITLE: Database recovery wedge
incidents.ORIGINAL_FAILURE: After one transient 57P03 the worker never left recovery mode because discard() after a successful probe raised a lost-client error.
incidents.ROOT_CAUSE: discard() reused the flag that detects a lost connection.
incidents.FIX: src/theta/runtime-postgres-client.ts treats discard() after a successful operation as destroy-on-release, not a lost client; the recovery gate remains in tools/theta-database-recovery-gate.mjs.

REGRESSION_TEST.titleFragment: discard() after a SUCCESSFUL operation returns the result
database recovery gate requires four healthy fresh probes

incidents.TITLE: Identity and replay integrity
incidents.ORIGINAL_FAILURE: Replay bundles or action plans could be altered without detection, and identity fields could be corrupted.
incidents.ROOT_CAUSE: Integrity hashes did not cover the whole bundle or every plan row.
incidents.FIX: src/theta/cycle-archive-replay.ts and src/execution/action-plan-integrity.ts verify whole-bundle and plan-row integrity and fail closed.

REGRESSION_TEST.titleFragment: TAMPER: every single persisted leaf
FUZZ plan rows
